english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the operator of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which a London private hire vehicle licence related, used the vehicle on a road in London, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the

(A)_[disc]_
(B)_[plate]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2), (4) and (7) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes: Section 10(6) provides that it is a defence in proceedings for an offence under section 10(4) for the operator to show that he exercised all due diligence to prevent the vehicle being used in contravention of section 10(2).
